log: The CivilDisorder and CelebrateLeader checks at player turn start each called city.yields(), which processes every Yield, YieldModifier and Cost rule. Nothing changes between the two, so they now share one result (civ-clone/web-renderer#315). That is 182 of ~2,000 yields calls in a late-game turn of the turn-247 save.
test: spy on the city's yields at turn start rather than counting calls by hand
City#yields() processes every Yield, YieldModifier and Cost rule, and these checks asked for it again with nothing changed in between (civ-clone/web-renderer#315):

disorder: calmCity works out the yields once to start and once after each tile it toggles, and passes them to disorderRisk, inDisorder, willGrow and the food balance. inDisorder copies the array before adding the extra Unhappiness instead of pushing into it.
defence: martialLawUnitsIn and martialLawUnitsWanted take the yields from callers that need both (wantsMartialLawUnit, keepsOrder, standDown's unitsWanted).
spendTreasury: one result for netShields and wantsMartialLawUnit.
The decisions are the same; only the number of Yield objects made (and so ids) changes. On the turn-247 save, the AI's calls fall from ~1,090 to ~710 a turn.
